arrivals.how: Non-resident visitors entering Canada by air at each port of entry (Statistics Canada 24-10-0055): overnight tourists by year and month, by country of residence. A port of entry is where a visitor first enters Canada, not where they stay. Calgary = YYC; Toronto = Pearson; Canada and Alberta = every airport.
